svg.text: Three-tier, layered ASP.NET Core MVC application · red numbers trace the “book an appointment” request in section 3.2
Razor-rendered HTML pages styled with Bootstrap (responsive, one navigation per role)
jQuery Validation: the same data-annotation rules checked before submit
Chart.js (local copy): weight, BMI, calories and vitals trends from JSON actions
healthtrack.js: polls /Notifications/Poll every 60 s for the bell badge and toasts
Kestrel, behind IIS Express in development or IIS when deployed, serves HealthTrack.Web over HTTPS
ASP.NET Core MVC · .NET 8 · C# 12 · Entity Framework Core 8 · ASP.NET Core Identity
role claims; security stamp re-checked every minute
Authorization: sign-in fallback policy and role
Services + HealthCalculator: business rules, calculations, ownership checks, transactions
HealthCalculator (static): BMI · BMI category · age · BMR (Mifflin–St Jeor) · TDEE · calorie target · calories burned (MET)
20 DbSets + Identity tables; Fluent API for keys,
precision, indexes, check constraints, delete rules
Value converter encrypts six text columns
Seeds roles, an admin, trainers, clients,
libraries and 8 weeks of demo activity
All queries are LINQ → parameterised SQL
SQL Server Express LocalDB, database HealthTrackDb
File access limited to the app
writes .eml files, so demos work offline
